points.statement: The unified approach addresses the challenge of achieving high restoration quality across multiple degradation types while maintaining computational efficiency.
points.quote: This unified approach addresses the challenge of achieving high restoration quality across multiple degradation types while maintaining computational efficiency.

points.statement: The approach centers on alternating spatial and channel attention inside transformer blocks at both encoder and decoder levels.
points.quote: At the core of our approach lies an alternating spatial and channel attention mechanism embedded within each transformer block across both encoder and decoder levels.
